               OpEntryPoint Fragment %main "main" %in_var_TEXCOORD0 %out_var_SV_Target
               OpExecutionMode %main OriginUpperLeft
          %4 = OpString "/app/example.hlsl"
          %5 = OpString "virtual-source.hlsl"
               OpSource HLSL 600 %4 "//==========================================================================//
// Line numbers in these panes are shifted by this banner, which Compiler Explorer
// prepends to the source before compiling. Compare positions, not the numbers in
// the local capture.
//
// The source has one statement before a #line directive and one after it. In the
// two DXIL panes, look at the !DILocation nodes at the bottom of the output: both
// statements are described by physical positions in this file, and every !DIFile
// names this file. The directive's own file name appears only inside
// !dx.source.contents, which is the compiler echoing the source back, not a debug
// location.
//
// In the SPIR-V pane the same compiler on the same source does the opposite: the
// statement after the directive gets an OpLine referring to a second OpString,
// the file the directive names.
//
// Compiler Explorer's oldest DXC is 1.6.2112, which is already past the change
// this issue is about, so no pane here shows the earlier behaviour.
//==========================================================================//

// Issue 4615 repro: DXIL debug locations vs #line directives.
// PHYSICAL LINE NUMBERS ARE LOAD-BEARING - do not add, remove or reflow lines.
Texture2D<float4> g_tex : register(t0);
SamplerState g_smp : register(s0);

float4 main(float2 uv : TEXCOORD0) : SV_Target {
  float4 before = g_tex.Sample(g_smp, uv);
#line 400 \"virtual-source.hlsl\"
  return before * 2.0f;
}
"
               OpSource HLSL 600 %5
               OpName %type_2d_image "type.2d.image"
               OpName %g_tex "g_tex"
               OpName %type_sampler "type.sampler"
               OpName %g_smp "g_smp"
               OpName %in_var_TEXCOORD0 "in.var.TEXCOORD0"
               OpName %out_var_SV_Target "out.var.SV_Target"
               OpName %main "main"
               OpName %type_sampled_image "type.sampled.image"
               OpDecorate %in_var_TEXCOORD0 Location 0
               OpDecorate %out_var_SV_Target Location 0
               OpDecorate %g_tex DescriptorSet 0
               OpDecorate %g_tex Binding 0
               OpDecorate %g_smp DescriptorSet 0
               OpDecorate %g_smp Binding 0
      %float = OpTypeFloat 32
    %float_2 = OpConstant %float 2
%type_2d_image = OpTypeImage %float 2D 2 0 0 1 Unknown
%_ptr_UniformConstant_type_2d_image = OpTypePointer UniformConstant %type_2d_image
%type_sampler = OpTypeSampler
%_ptr_UniformConstant_type_sampler = OpTypePointer UniformConstant %type_sampler
    %v2float = OpTypeVector %float 2
%_ptr_Input_v2float = OpTypePointer Input %v2float
    %v4float = OpTypeVector %float 4
%_ptr_Output_v4float = OpTypePointer Output %v4float
       %void = OpTypeVoid
         %20 = OpTypeFunction %void
%type_sampled_image = OpTypeSampledImage %type_2d_image
      %g_tex = OpVariable %_ptr_UniformConstant_type_2d_image UniformConstant
      %g_smp = OpVariable %_ptr_UniformConstant_type_sampler UniformConstant
%in_var_TEXCOORD0 = OpVariable %_ptr_Input_v2float Input
%out_var_SV_Target = OpVariable %_ptr_Output_v4float Output
               OpLine %4 26 1
       %main = OpFunction %void None %20
               OpNoLine
         %21 = OpLabel
               OpLine %4 26 1

               OpLine %4 27 19
         %23 = OpLoad %type_2d_image %g_tex
               OpLine %4 27 32
         %24 = OpLoad %type_sampler %g_smp
               OpLine %4 27 19

         %26 = OpImageSampleImplicitLod %v4float %25 %22 None
               OpLine %5 400 16
         %27 = OpVectorTimesScalar %v4float %26 %float_2
               OpLine %4 26 1
               OpStore %out_var_SV_Target %27
               OpLine %5 401 1
               OpReturn
               OpFunctionEnd
